result.rationale: The diff explicitly shows `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }` in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts. Callers (e.g., GoogleCalendarService) persist the parsed key via prisma.credential.update, so a response missing refresh_token is silently patched with a literal bogus string, masking a failed refresh and corrupting stored credentials.
